notablePrerequisites:
Plaguemaw Beast does not have summoning sickness.
Herd Baloth has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Plaguemaw Beast.
description:
Activate Plaguemaw Beast by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Plaguemaw Beast triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Plaguemaw Beast ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
